epics.title: Normative Regulatory Verification, Autonomous Scraping & Freshness Monitor
epics.jtbd: When an educational administrator, instructor, or resident queries regulatory guidance, I want an autonomous verification engine that continuously crawls, monitors, and validates active regulatory acts across CRIE residency and postgraduate specialties, purging repealed documents and providing an on-demand freshness audit, so that all assistant recommendations strictly rely on current law and accreditation standards.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Zero citations of repealed or outdated normative acts in assistant responses (100% active edition compliance)
epics.tocConstraintRef: CRIE specialty-scoped normative document collection and status validation throughput
requirements: R1: Automated collection and monitoring of normative-legal acts (NPA, SanPiN, SP, Minzdrav/Minobrnauki orders, FGOS VO, VAK passports) strictly scoped to CRIE specialties (Residency: 32.08.12 Epidemiology, 31.08.35 Infectious Diseases, 31.08.19 Pediatrics; Postgraduate: 3.2.2 Epidemiology, 3.1.22 Infectious Diseases; Microbiology explicitly excluded)

R2: Legal status verification engine detecting and removing repealed (утратившие силу) acts from the active corpus and LLM retrieval context, strictly preventing the assistant from referencing invalid regulations
R3: Assistant retrieval grounding guarantee ensuring AI responses and generated templates cite only current, in-force editions of normative acts with verified revision dates
R4: Autonomous weekly scheduler (cron-based background task runner) executing periodic status synchronization, novelty checks, and corpus re-indexing without manual intervention

R5: Interactive UI 'Freshness' (Актуальность) indicator showing the latest synchronization timestamp and status, paired with a manual force-sync trigger button providing immediate visual progress and feedback

slices.title: Define Normative Freshness & Sync REST API Contract (BARCAN-TAG-12)
slices.jtbd: When defining interface boundaries for regulatory sync and freshness monitoring, I want to establish OpenAPI specifications and TypeScript/Pydantic schemas for verification status, trigger endpoints, and specialty filter scopes, so that frontend and backend implementations can proceed against a verified contract.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the OpenAPI contract definition for /api/normative/freshness and /api/normative/sync,
When examining request and response schemas,
Then the sync status model includes last_checked_at, active_count, repealed_count, and specialty_breakdown;
And the trigger endpoint defines synchronous or queued job status responses with explicit error states.
slices.tocConstraintRef: API schema alignment between scheduler backend and UI controls
slices.sixSigmaMetric: 100% schema conformance across request/response DTO validations

slices.title: CRIE Specialty Normative Corpus Schema & Repeal Status Metadata (BARCAN-TAG-08)
slices.jtbd: When persisting regulatory acts and validity states, I want an enhanced corpus schema with status tags (active, repealed, superseded), legal authority metadata, and strict CRIE specialty mapping (32.08.12, 31.08.35, 31.08.19, 3.2.2, 3.1.22), so that invalid acts are deterministically filtered from vector and inverted indices.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a catalog entry for a SanPiN or Minzdrav order,
When its status is updated to 'repealed' or an effective end date is reached,
Then its active search flag is toggled to false and inverted index tokens for the document are pruned;
And documents matching excluded scopes (such as general microbiology) are quarantined and omitted from query indices.
slices.tocConstraintRef: Document index filtering and status-partitioned query throughput
slices.sixSigmaMetric: 0% false active retention rate for revoked or superseded documents

slices.title: Regulatory Monitor, Autonomous Weekly Scheduler & Safe Retrieval Guard (BARCAN-TAG-02)
slices.jtbd: When operating the assistant backend, I want an autonomous weekly scheduler and status verification service that audits official registry feeds, updates document statuses, and enforces an active-only retrieval filter in the DeepSeek/RAG pipeline, so that users receive legally sound answers and operators can trigger ad-hoc checks.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an autonomous weekly scheduler configured in FastAPI/Python,
When the scheduled job runs or an authorized operator invokes POST /api/normative/sync,
Then document status revisions are fetched, expired acts are evicted from the active context, and a freshness summary record is persisted;
And RAG retrieval queries strictly reject any document lacking a verified 'active' status flag.
slices.tocConstraintRef: Scheduled sync execution reliability and LLM prompt context sanitizer latency
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Sub-50ms retrieval filter latency overhead with zero repealed document leakage

slices.title: Interactive 'Freshness' Status Indicator & On-Demand Sync Control (BARCAN-TAG-11)
slices.jtbd: When an educational user or administrator interacts with the knowledge base, I want an accessible 'Актуальность' badge showing the current database sync state and a responsive button to force an immediate verification check, so that stakeholders have full visibility and confidence in the normative corpus.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the knowledge base UI rendered on desktop or mobile viewport (375px+),
When viewing the header/search toolbar,
Then a high-contrast 'Актуальность' badge displays the last successful verification time and status conforming to WCAG 2.1 AA (4.5:1 minimum contrast);
And clicking the manual check button initiates a progress indicator with visible status feedback and updates the view upon completion without losing user input.
slices.tocConstraintRef: User feedback latency during on-demand synchronization
slices.sixSigmaMetric: 100% WCAG 2.1 AA keyboard navigation and accessible name compliance for freshness controls

slices.title: Full-Pyramid Verification for Normative Monitoring & Retrieval Filtering (BARCAN-TAG-06)
slices.jtbd: When verifying the regulatory monitor and assistant grounding, I want a complete test suite spanning unit tests, API integration tests, and E2E browser flows, so that repealed act eviction, weekly scheduling, and UI freshness triggers are objectively proven.
slices.tocConstraintRef: Automated CI regression detection time across the test pyramid
slices.sixSigmaMetric: 100% pass rate on status validation tests and zero repealed document retrieval leaks
